Definition: Whether the instant payment system enables or plans to enable instant payments across national borders to other countries or regional payment systems, supporting remittances, trade, and regional integration.
Comments: Togo has partial cross-border digital payment functionality via regional WAEMU rails (e.g., GIM‑UEMOA for regional card/payment switching) and bank-led instant international transfers (Ecobank partnership with Thunes enabling real-time send/receive across 130+ countries), but not evidenced as a single universal cross-border instant system for all providers.

Definition: Whether the country has established or is actively developing an instant/real-time payment system (IPS/RTP) that enables digital payments with near-instant settlement (typically within seconds), available 24/7/365. This includes both bank-led and mobile money interoperability systems.
Comments: BCEAO launched the interoperable Instant Payments Platform (PI‑PSI / PI‑SPI) for WAEMU on 30 Sep 2025; in Togo, only a subset of banks (e.g., Coris Bank, Ecobank, Orabank) were initially operational, with others joining later—indicating partial deployment rather than universal adoption across all PSPs.
